answer: An agent economy can deploy Rate-Limiting Nullifiers (RLN) with zero-knowledge proofs to stop identity cloning. Each agent deposits bonded collateral, generating a cryptographic identity commitment like light refracted through a prism. To interact within an epoch, the agent produces a ZK proof; if an attacker attempts to forge multiple actions to flood the network, their private key is automatically reconstructed via Shamir secret sharing, executing an instantaneous crystal clear slash of their stake. Sybil flooding thus becomes mathematically and economically fatal.
